Function Index & S3 Class System Breakdown

modules.Rmd

Function Index & S3 Class System Breakdown

foundr organizes its source code across 45+ source files in R/. Functions are grouped into five core architectural categories:

1. Data Analysis & Statistical Modeling

Function Primary Role / Description Source File
partition() Decomposes raw trait values into orthogonal signal, rest, and noise terms R/partition.R
strainstats() Computes strain/sex/condition summary stats, standard deviations, cell means, and ANOVA F-tests R/strainstats.R
conditionContrasts() Calculates differences and contrasts between experimental conditions across founder strains R/conditionContrasts.R
bestcor() Identifies top correlated traits across founder strains using Spearman rank correlation R/bestcor.R
eigen_cor() / eigen_contrast() Computes eigentrait correlations and condition contrast eigentrait projections R/eigentrait.R
traitAncova() Performs Analysis of Covariance (ANCOVA) combining continuous covariates and strain factors R/traitAncova.R

2. Trait S3 Class System & Method Dispatch

foundr implements custom S3 classes to encapsulate structured trait data and provide unified visualization & summary APIs.

S3 Classes

  • traitSolos: Represents single-trait data structured for strain comparisons (R/traitSolos.R).
  • traitPairs: Encapsulates bivariate trait comparisons, joint distributions, and correlations (R/traitPairs.R).
  • traitTimes: Wraps time-series measurement trajectories over time points (R/traitTimes.R).
  • conditionContrasts: Encapsulates condition contrast effect estimates and p-values (R/conditionContrasts.R).

Standardized S3 Generics

Each S3 trait class supports standard S3 generics: - autoplot() / plot(): Generate ggplot2 visual representations. - summary(): Produce numerical summaries and strain contrast tables. - subset() / split() / c(): Manipulate, slice, or combine trait objects seamlessly.

3. Module Analysis & WGCNA Integration

foundr integrates with WGCNA module outputs to analyze co-expression gene modules alongside physiological phenotypes:

  • module_kMEs(): Extracts module eigengene kME values for specified traits (R/module_kMEs.R).
  • module_band(): Computes module band intervals across founder strain trait signals (R/module_band.R).
  • wgcnaModules() / listof_wgcnaModules(): Constructors for managing single and list-of-WGCNA module specifications (R/wgcnaModules.R).

4. Visualization & Biplot Engine

All plot generators in foundr build upon the centralized ggplot_template() design system:

Plot Function Description Source File
ggplot_template() Core styling template (Okabe-Ito CC color palette, custom themes, facet options) R/ggplot_template.R
ggplot_traitSolos() Bar charts and point plots for single trait strain values R/traitSolos.R
ggplot_traitPairs() Scatter plots and correlation grids for paired traits R/traitPairs.R
ggplot_traitTimes() Longitudinal trajectory plots across experimental time points R/traitTimes.R
volcano() Volcano plots mapping effect size against statistical significance (−log⁡10(p)-\log_{10}(p)) R/volcano.R
biplot_signal() / biplot_pca() PCA biplot visualizations powered by the ordr package R/biplot.R
ggplot_evidence_spread() Evidence spread and rank variance dot plots R/evidence_spread.R

5. Utilities & Data Transformation Helpers

  • nqrank() / normalscores(): Normal quantile rank transformations for non-Gaussian trait normalization (R/nqrank.R).
  • area_under_curve(): Integrates trait values across longitudinal time points (R/area_under_curve.R).
  • unite_datatraits() / pivot_pair(): Reshaping helpers for combining dataset names and trait identifiers (R/trait_names.R).
  • timetraits() / separate_time(): Utilities for parsing time component tags from trait string names (R/timetraits.R).
